title: 헌법재판소보안관리대 설치 및 운영에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00471:20240701:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 헌법재판소보안관리대 설치 및 운영에 관한 규칙
full_text:
ADDENDUM <No. 471, July 1, 2024>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.
Article 2 (Amendment of Other Rules)
(1) Part of the Rules on Constitutional Court Public Officials shall be amended as follows:
Article 90-2 shall be newly inserted as follows:
Article 90-2 (Designation, etc. of Field-Duty Public Officials)
(1) The Secretary General may designate as field-duty public officials those public officials for whom it is necessary, due to the nature of their duties, to maintain a continuous-duty system or to work normal hours on Saturdays or public holidays, and may cancel such designation where the necessity ceases to exist.
(2) Matters concerning working hours, working days, service management, overtime allowances, etc. of field-duty public officials shall be determined by the Secretary General.
(2) Part of the Rules on Security Affairs of the Constitutional Court shall be amended as follows:
The title "Rules on Security Affairs of the Constitutional Court" shall be changed to "Rules on Classified Information Management Affairs of the Constitutional Court."
In Article 1, "security affairs" shall be replaced with "classified information management affairs."
In Article 3, the title "(Security Responsibility)" shall be changed to "(Responsibility for Classified Information Management)," and "security responsibility" in the text shall be replaced with "responsibility for classified information management."
In Article 7 (4) 1, "security incident" shall be replaced with "classified information incident," and "security affairs" with "classified information management affairs."
In Article 13 (2) 2, "for maintenance of security" shall be replaced with "for maintenance of classified information management."
In Article 21 (1) proviso, "security officer (hereinafter referred to as 'security officer')" shall be replaced with "classified information management officer (hereinafter referred to as 'classified information management officer')."
In Article 21 (3) 2, "emergency planning officer of the General Affairs Division of the Administrative Management Bureau" shall be replaced with "emergency preparedness officer (specialized career official) of the General Affairs Division of the Administrative Management Bureau."
In Article 21 (4), "security officer" shall be replaced with "classified information management officer."
In Article 21 (7), "security incident" shall be replaced with "classified information incident."
In Article 22 (4), "security officer" shall be replaced with "classified information management officer."
In Article 24 (2) and (3), "security officer" shall be replaced with "classified information management officer."
In Article 24 (4), "security measures" shall be replaced with "classified information protection measures."
In Article 24 (5), "security officer" shall be replaced with "classified information management officer."
In Article 27 (1), "security officer" shall be replaced with "classified information management officer."
In Article 27 (3), "security measures" shall be replaced with "classified information management measures."
In Article 29 (1) and (2), "security officer" shall be replaced with "classified information management officer."
In Article 32 (1), "security officer" shall be replaced with "classified information management officer."
In Article 37 (4), "security officer" shall be replaced with "classified information management officer."
In Article 37 (5), "security measures" shall be replaced with "classified information management measures."
The title of Article 38 "(Investigation of Security Incidents)" shall be changed to "(Investigation of Classified Information Incidents)."
In Article 38 (1), "protected zone" shall be replaced with "protected area."
In the main sentence of Article 38 (2), "security incident" shall be replaced with "classified information incident" and "security officer" with "classified information management officer."
In Article 38 (3), "security officer" shall be replaced with "classified information management officer."
The title of Article 39 "(Security Audit)" shall be changed to "(Regular Audit)."
In Article 39 (1), "security management status" shall be replaced with "classified information management status."
In Article 39 (2) through (5), "security officer" shall be replaced with "classified information management officer."
In Article 39-2 (2) and (3), "security officer" shall be replaced with "classified information management officer."
The title of Article 40 "(Security Officer)" shall be changed to "(Classified Information Management Officer)."
In Article 40 (1), "security affairs" shall be replaced with "classified information management affairs," and "security officer" with "classified information management officer."
In Article 40 (2), "security officer" shall be replaced with "classified information management officer"; in subparagraph 1, "security affairs" with "classified information management affairs"; and in subparagraph 2, "security education" with "classified information management education."
The title of Article 41 "(Security Education)" shall be changed to "(Classified Information Management Education)."
In Article 41 (1), "security officer" shall be replaced with "classified information management officer," "security education" with "classified information management education," and "security measures" with "classified information protection measures."
In Article 41 (2), "security officer" shall be replaced with "classified information management officer," and "security maintenance policy" with "classified information management maintenance policy."
In Article 41 (3), "security officer" shall be replaced with "classified information management officer," and "security education" with "classified information management education."
In Form 10, "To the Security Officer" shall be replaced with "To the Classified Information Management Officer."
In Form 15, "6. Security Measures" shall be replaced with "6. Management Measures."
In Form 24, "2. I shall comply with security-related regulations" shall be replaced with "2. I shall comply with classified-information-related regulations."
In Form 26, in the table of reasons for denial of new security-clearance applicants, "vulnerability in security management" shall be replaced with "vulnerability in classified information management"; and in the table on cancellation of existing security clearances, "security incident/violation of regulations" shall be replaced with "classified information incident/violation of regulations."
